title: Technology Licensing Opportunity: Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements
description: Note: This is a technology licensing opportunity. No procurement, grants, or funding opportunities are associated with this notice. Room-Temperature Electrochemical Metallization of Rare Earth Elements A low-energy, low-hazard alternative to molten-salt electrolysis for sustainable REE production. Technology Summary This invention introduces a method to produce metallic rare earth elements (REEs) through room-temperature electrometallization in anhydrous electrolytes. By leveraging unique ion-pairing interactions, Lewis acid-base chemistry, and interfacial structuring, the system enables efficient REE reduction and stable metal formation without the extreme energy use or toxic byproducts of conventional fused salt electrolysis. Problem Addressed High cost & regulatory barriers: Current molten-salt electrolysis (600�1200 �C) generates toxic HF gas and rare earth fluoride waste, triggering costly EPA and OSHA compliance requirements. Environmental impact: Legacy processes produce hazardous waste with long-term contamination risks, leading to industry abandonment in North America. Supply chain dependence: Metallic REEs are only produced at scale in China, creating vulnerabilities for U.S. manufacturers and defense applications. Solution The invention replaces high-temperature fused salt electrolysis with an ambient-temperature electrochemical process. The approach integrates three synergistic innovations: Tuned electrolyte nucleophilicity � enabling more efficient reduction pathways. Lewis acid-base coordination control � stabilizing the ligand environment during deposition. Interfacial electrochemical structuring � improving reaction kinetics and metal stability. This combination allows REE electrodeposition at room temperature, reducing both energy demand and hazardous byproduct formation. This invention enables dual functionality, electrodeposition and (in-situ) electrorefining. Key Advantages Lower energy consumption � eliminates the need for 600�1200 �C molten salt processes. Reduced environmental liabilities � avoids HF gas emissions and toxic fluoride salt accumulation. Safer operations � circumvents EPA and RCRA compliance barriers tied to FSE. Domestic supply potential � enables North American REE production for critical industries. Scalable platform � adaptable to multiple REEs including neodymium, samarium, dysprosium, and terbium. Market Applications Permanent magnets � essential for EV traction motors, wind turbines, and energy-efficient refrigeration. Defense systems � critical components for satellites, communication devices, and advanced weapons. Lightweight alloys � enhancing aerospace and automotive materials. Electronics � miniaturized devices requiring REE-based components. Battery technologies � advanced REE-containing chemistries for high-performance storage.

Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. title: Henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut 2027-2029 (2030)
description: Henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut 2027-2029 (2030) Hankinnan kohteena on Jyväskylän kaupungin henkilöstöön kuuluvien esimiesten ja työyhteisöjen osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, sillä jakaminen ei palvelun luonteen vuoksi ole tarkoituksenmukaista eikä jaosta saada selkeää. Sen sijaan poolista tehdään melko suuri, jotta saadaan laaja-alainen asiantuntijuus turvattua. Palveluiden hankinta voidaan toteuttaa joko henkilöstöhallinnon tai työyksiköiden esimiesten hankkimana tilanteissa, joissa on havaittu kehittämistarvetta. Tuleva hankinta koskee kaikkia Jyväskylän kaupungin toimialoja ja liikelaitoksia. Tarjouskilpailulla muodostetaan 15 yrityksen/toimijan pooli, tai useamman, mikäli mukaan ei saada vähintään 25 valmentajaa. Jos soveltuvia tarjouksia on vähemmän kuin 15, valitaan kaikki soveltuvat tarjoukset. Jotta turvataan pientenkin toimijoiden pääseminen hankintaan mukaan, rinnakkaisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä, ja yksi yritys/toimija voi tarjota 1-3 asiantuntijaa pooliin. Palvelun käynnistämisen tavoiteaika on 1.3.2027. Lisätiedot hankinnan kohteesta tarjouspyynnöstä ja sen liitteistä.,

title: Vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut
description: Vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut Hankinnan kohteena on vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut Kainuun hyvinvointialueella. Palvelun kohteena ovat Tilaajan Toimeksiantosopimuksissa määrittelemät kohteet. Turvallisuuspalvelut sisältävät paikallisvartiointia, kiertävä vartiointi (ent. piirivartiointi), hälytys- ja tilausvartiointia. Vartiointipalveluiden tarkoituksena on ylläpitää ja edistää turvallisuutta sovituilla vartioimisalueilla ja -kohteissa, sekä tarvittaessa ryhtyä lain (Laki yksityisistä turvallisuuspalveluista 1085/2015) sallimissa rajoissa toimenpiteisiin turvallisuuden palauttamiseksi. Vartiointi - ja hälytyskeskuspalvelu koostuu mm. seuraavista palveluista (tarkemmin kuvattu Palvelukuvauksessa (liite 6): -Paikallisvartiointi; siihen liittyvä tilausvartiointi (yksittäinen tehtävä etukäteen tilattu) -Hälytyskäynnit -Kiertävä vartiointi (ent. piirivartiointi) -Hälytyskeskuspalvelu (esim. murtohälytysjärjestelmien testaus/hälytyksen siirrot, hälytysten vastaanottaminen) -Henkilöturvaan, omaisuuteen ja kiinteistöön liittyvät hälytykset Kainuun hyvinvointialueen toimitiloissa ja kiinteistöissä (mm. ovien kiinniolojen seuranta, jääkaappihälytykset, N-kaappien hälytykset, henkilöstön avustaminen pukukaappien avauksessa) -Yleiset kiinteistön pitoon liittyvät aputyöt (esim. puku- ja laukkukaappien avaukset vikatilanteessa, tarvittaessa pukukaappien tarkastukset), Vuototilanteissa huolto/kalustesulkujen sulkeminen (päivystävä huoltomies ohjeistaa), lipunnosto Kainuun keskussairaalassa -Aula- ja paikallisvartiointipalvelut Kainuun keskussairaalassa: (esim. väliaikaisten kulkuoikeuksien ja - lupien hallinta, palohälytyksiin reagointi ja keskussairaalan kuulutukset) Hälytyskeskuspalvelut sisältyvät toimeksiantosopimukseen ilman erillistä korvausta palvelukuvauksen mukaisesti. Hälytyskeskuspalvelun tarkoituksena on jatkuva päivystäminen (24/7 palvelu), joka mahdollistaa erilaisten palvelupyyntöjen vastaanottamisen ja niihin reagoimisen.,

title: Henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut 2027-2029 (2030)
description: Henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut 2027-2029 (2030) Hankinnan kohteena on Jyväskylän kaupungin henkilöstöön kuuluvien esimiesten ja työyhteisöjen osaamisen kehittämisen palvelut. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, sillä jakaminen ei palvelun luonteen vuoksi ole tarkoituksenmukaista eikä jaosta saada selkeää. Sen sijaan poolista tehdään melko suuri, jotta saadaan laaja-alainen asiantuntijuus turvattua. Palveluiden hankinta voidaan toteuttaa joko henkilöstöhallinnon tai työyksiköiden esimiesten hankkimana tilanteissa, joissa on havaittu kehittämistarvetta. Tuleva hankinta koskee kaikkia Jyväskylän kaupungin toimialoja ja liikelaitoksia. Tarjouskilpailulla muodostetaan 15 yrityksen/toimijan pooli, tai useamman, mikäli mukaan ei saada vähintään 25 valmentajaa. Jos soveltuvia tarjouksia on vähemmän kuin 15, valitaan kaikki soveltuvat tarjoukset. Jotta turvataan pientenkin toimijoiden pääseminen hankintaan mukaan, rinnakkaisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä, ja yksi yritys/toimija voi tarjota 1-3 asiantuntijaa pooliin. Palvelun käynnistämisen tavoiteaika on 1.3.2027. Lisätiedot hankinnan kohteesta tarjouspyynnöstä ja sen liitteistä.,

title: Finland – Public road transport services – Reittipohjaiset joukkoliikennepalvelut, brutto, tarjouskilpailu 2026-15
description: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficom (jäljempänä Traficom) pyytää tarjousta joukkoliikennepalvelujen hoitamisesta ajalla 7.6.2027-2.6.2030 reitillä Mynämäki-Nousiainen-Masku-Turku (tarkempi kohdemäärittely tarjouspyynnön liitteessä). Sopimus sisältää option sopimuksen jatkamisesta ajalle 3.6.2030 - 5.6.2033. Tarkat liikennöinnin aloitus ja lopetuspäivät määräytyvät kouluvuoden mukaisesti. Liikenne hankitaan bruttosopimuksella. Bruttosopimuksella tarkoitetaan palvelusopimusasetuksen (1370 /2007) ja erityisalojen hankintalain (1398/2016) tarkoittamaa joukkoliikenteen palvelusopimusta, jossa lipputuloriski on liikenteen tilaajalla. Tämän hankinnan sisältämälle liikenteelle myönnetään palvelusopimusasetuksen mukainen yksinoikeus erillisellä hallinnollisella päätöksellä. Yksinoikeuspäätöksessä otetaan huomioon mahdollinen reitin osan läpi kulkeva pidempimatkainen liikenne. Lippu- ja maksujärjestelmävaatimukset sekä liikennepalvelulain (320/2017) edellyttämät yhteentoimivuusvaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Maskun, Mynämäen ja Nousiaisten kunnat osallistuvat kohteen rahoitukseen.

title: Finland – Real estate services – Syväkeräysastioiden vuosihuollot / VAV
description: Tilaajan tavoitteena on hankkia joustava ja luotettava yhteistyökumppani Vantaalla sijaitsevien VAV-konsernin omistamien vuokratalokohteiden syväkeräysjätepisteiden vuosihuoltoihin. VAV-konserni omistaa noin 12 000 vuokra-asuntoa, joissa asuu noin 19 000 asukasta. Tarkempi luettelo sopimuksen piiriin kuuluvista syväkeräyskohteista on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa kohdeluettelossa. Sopimus ei sisällä määräostovelvoitetta, eikä Tilaaja sitoudu tarjouspyynnössä tai hankintailmoituksessa esitettyihin arvioihin hankintamääristä. Työtilauksiin voi sisältyä myös tarvikehankintoja ja muita työn suorittamiseen liittyviä palveluhankintoja. Tavoitteiden saavuttamisen edellytykset on kerrottu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön ESPD-lomakkeella, hankinnan kohteen kriteerit -osiossa sekä hankintailmoituksen liitteissä. Hankintapäätöksen tekoperusteena on kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus pisteytyksen mukaisesti, jossa maksimipisteet ovat 1000 pistettä. Tarjoajan on annettava tarjous kaikista tarjouslomakkeen töistä. Mikäli Tarjoaja ei ole tarjonnut kaikkia tarjouslomakkeeseen eriteltyjä töitä, tulkitaan tarjous puutteelliseksi. Puutteellinen tarjous hylätään. Tarjoajan kannalta huomioitavaa on myös se, että tarjottujen töiden ja hintojen tulee sisältää kaikki tässä tarjouspyynnössä, hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ja palvelukuvauksessa määritellyt kriteerit. Palvelu toteutetaan tarjouspyynnön, palvelukuvauksen ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Tarjoajan antama tarjous on sitova. Hankintasopimus syntyy vasta kirjallisen sopimuksen allekirjoittamisella, selonottoneuvottelujen jälkeen. EU-kynnysarvon ylittävässä hankinnassa sopimus voidaan tehdä aikaisintaan 14 vuorokauden kuluttua siitä, kun Tarjoaja on saanut tai hänen katsotaan saaneen päätöksen perusteluineen tiedoksi. Tarjoaja ei saa esittää esimerkiksi omissa tarjousasiakirjoissaan ehtoja, jotka vaikuttaisivat hankintasopimuksen sisältöön. Sopimuskauden tavoitealkamisajankohta on 1.2.2027 ja sopimus on voimassa toistaiseksi, kuuden (6) kuukauden irtisanomisajalla.

title: Finland – Maintenance services of public-lighting installations and traffic lights – Valaistusverkon huolto- ja kunnossapitotyöt 2027-2028 (2030)
description: Hollolan kunta (jäljempänä "Tilaaja") hakee tällä tarjouspyynnöllä kunnan valaistusverkon huolto- ja kunnossapitotöille puitesopimuskumppanin sopimuskaudelle 1.1.2027 – 31.12.2028. Sopimukseen sisältyy lisäksi kaksi (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiokautta (1.1.2029-31.12.2029 ja 1.1.2030-31.12.2030). Tilaaja ilmoittaa option käyttämisestä sopimustoimittajalle kirjallisesti viimeistään kolme (3) kuukautta ennen voimassa olevan sopimuskauden päättymistä. Option käyttäminen on tilaajan harkinnassa eikä tilaaja sitoudu optiokauden käyttämiseen. Hankinta käsittää vuosittaiset huoltokierrokset, erikseen tilattavat huolto-, kunnossapito- sekä pienet saneeraus- ja uudistyöt, ympärivuorokautisen vikapäivystyksen (vasteaika 2,0 tuntia), valaistusverkon dokumentoinnin sekä valaistusverkon käytönjohtajan tehtävän. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteissä 1 (Palvelukuvaus) ja 2 (Urakkaohjelma).

title: Evaluering- Operativt SaLTo
description: Bydel Alna har behov for ekstern bistand til evaluering av prosjektet Operativt SaLTo. Prosjektet dreier seg om å finne nye metoder for å motvirke og forebygge ungdomskriminalitet. Evalueringen skal gi et faglig og operativt beslutningsgrunnlag for videreutvikling, videreføring og eventuell implementering av prosjektets samarbeidsmodell og arbeidsmetodikk. Oppdraget skal belyse hvordan modellen fungerer i praksis, identifisere hvilke deler som bør videreføres, justeres eller avsluttes, og vurdere organisatoriske forutsetninger for videreføring. Et særskilt formål er å vurdere hvordan erfaringer, metoder og arbeidsformer fra prosjektet kan tas i bruk i ny organisasjon etter bydelsreform fra 2028. Estimert verdi på anskaffelsen er 700 000 kroner ekskl. mva.

title: Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) Modeling & Simulation Support
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is being issued by the Department of the Army, on behalf of Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Fires. PAE Fires is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to identify qualified, experienced, and interested sources capable of providing specialized engineering, modeling, simulation, and software support for the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) Project Office in support of the AN/TPY-2 Terminal Mode. The contractor shall provide support for development, integration, and testing of the THAAD Modeling and Simulation (M&S) products. The contractor shall deliver software products for the AN/TPY-2 Terminal Mode, including incremental development releases, Engineering Releases and Final Releases. The contractor shall deliver updated software documentation for AN/TPY-2 Terminal Mode, including appropriately red-lined documents. The contractor shall support integration of software into the THAAD M&S products, to include on-site support as needed. The contractor shall support the resolution of related observations made by the THAAD M&S products during all phases of development and integration, as well as on-going system testing. Note that this is not a request for quotes. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. This RFI seeks industry comments to assist the Government in locating potential sources with the ability to satisfy its requirement. Please provide the following Point of Contact Information: Company: Address: Point of Contact: Phone Number: Fax Numbers: Email Address: DUNS Number: CAGE Code: Business Size and Classification (Large Business, Small Business, 8(a), Woman-Owned/Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned, Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Veteran-Owned, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned): Potential sources are invited to submit a Capabilities Statement up to five (5) pages per each of the four (4) major tasks, as described above, to the "RFI: THAAD Modeling and Simulation Support". All responses should be submitted via e-mail address to jonathan.w.dickens.civ@army.mil and sean.c.allan.civ@mail.mil. Only attach MS Word/Excel compatible files or Adobe Acrobat PDF files in electronic correspondence. PM THAAD will not acknowledge receipt of responses to this RFI. Telephonic inquiries will not be considered.

title: Annual Service Contract with 4 option years on a flow cytometer system
description: Description - This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 124PSA27Q0012 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for the procurement of Annual Service Contract for Flow Cytometer with 4 Option year. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 811210 The small business size standard is $34.0 million. This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Statement of Requirement This requirement is for Annual Service Contract for Flow Cytometer with 4 Option year in accordance with the attached statement of work. Vendors are required to be active and registered in the System for Award Management at www.sam.gov when submitting a quote and at time of award (FAR 52.204-7(b)(1)). Payment will be made utilizing the Department of the Treasury Invoice Processing Platform at www.ipp.gov. SAM.gov and IPP.gov are free, official websites of the United States government. Quotes are due no later than 4:00 pm Central Standard Time on Thursday, November 10, 2026. Quotes must be submitted electronically, e-mailed to lynn.hults@usda.gov; no faxed or hard copy quotes are allowed. Responses must include a detailed description of the capability to provide Annual Service Contract for Flow Cytometer with 4 Option year, any relevant experience providing this type of data to other government agencies or organizations, and past performance history. Quotes that merely offer to provide the data as described in the SOW without any additional information will not receive further consideration for award. Questions Questions shall be submitted via email to lynn.hults@usda.gov and are due no later than Monday, November 6, 2025, at 3:00 PM Central Standard Time. This will ensure enough time to respond before the solicitation period ends. Please include the solicitation name and number as the subject line of the email. The final day for question submission is 3:00 pm Central Standard Time on Monday, November 6, 2026.

title: Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity-Multiple Award Contracts (IDIQ-MACs) at Mid-Atlantic Regional Maintenance Center (MARMC) for Next Generation Homeport CNO Availabilities
description: Portfolio Acquisition Executive Maritime (PAEM) is issuing solicitation N6117727R5001 for the award of the Mid-Atlantic Regional Maintenance Center (MARMC) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Contracts (IDIQ-MACs) for Continuous Maintenance Availabilities (CMAVs), Emergent Maintenance (EM), and short-term Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) availabilities. This solicitation is for the procurement of maintenance, repair and modernization of non-nuclear surface ships (including Guided-Missile Cruisers (CGs), Guided Missile Destroyers (DDGs), Expeditionary Sea Bases (ESBs), Guided-Missile Frigates (FFGs), Amphibious Command Ships (LCCs), Littoral Combat Ships (LCSs), Landing Helicopter Assaults (LHAs), Landing Helicopter Docks (LHDs), Landing Platform Docks (LPDs), Landing Ship Docks (LSDs), and Mine Countermeasures Ships (MCMs) homeported in or visiting the Norfolk region. PAEM intends to award IDIQ-MACs based on the qualifications and capabilities of the Contractor in the following two categories: MAC A, where all holders can complete all requirements; and MAC B, where all holders can complete work associated with CMAVs and EM on non-critical systems. MAC A will be solicited on a full and open basis. MAC B will be solicited as a Small Business Set Aide. MAC A � CMAV/EM includes work on critical systems. MAC A also includes short-term CNO availabilities. Due to the nature of critical systems and the likelihood of urgent requirements with critical EM, the Government will require contractors with the capability and capacity to respond immediately to critical technical requirements. It is anticipated that this work would be available under full and open competition. However, if it is determined that two or more small businesses are interested and capable of completing the scope of work under any given delivery order, contracting officers may use their discretion to restrict competition to small businesses. MAC B � CMAV/EM does not include work on critical systems but will include systems and equipment requiring work certification. The scope of non-critical contract actions is expected to require less contractor capabilities, both in human resources and facilities. MAC B will be a small business set aside. In the event that there is no interest expressed for any given delivery order, this work may be competed under MAC A. Offerors must possess or have the ability to obtain a Tier I, II, or III Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) for the Norfolk, VA homeport. Each contract will include five (5) one-year ordering periods. The supply being procured is the repaired, mission ready vessel, which is returned to service within the Fleet. The solicitation will be issued electronically via System for Award Management (SAM) at http://sam.gov and interested parties must comply with that announcement. Interested offerors should monitor the SAM.gov page for any applicable amendments to this solicitation. Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management in order to participate in this procurement at https://www.sam.gov/portal/public/SAM/. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, which shall be considered by the agency. SAM.gov is the single point of entry for posting of the synopsis and solicitations to the internet. This pre-solicitation notice is for information purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to solicit contractual offers or award of contracts. The Government is not soliciting, nor will it accept, proposals as a result of this synopsis. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any questions submitted or information provided as a result of this notice. The solicitation is forthcoming.

MAC A will be solicited on a full and open basis. MAC B will be solicited as a Small Business Set Aide. MAC A � CMAV/EM includes work on critical systems. MAC A also includes short-term CNO availabilities. Due to the nature of critical systems and the likelihood of urgent requirements with critical EM, the Government will require contractors with the capability and capacity to respond immediately to critical technical requirements. It is anticipated that this work would be available under full and open competition. However, if it is determined that two or more small businesses are interested and capable of completing the scope of work under any given delivery order, contracting officers may use their discretion to restrict competition to small businesses. MAC B � CMAV/EM does not include work on critical systems but will include systems and equipment requiring work certification. The scope of non-critical contract actions is expected to require less contractor capabilities, both in human resources and facilities. MAC B will be a small business set aside. In the event that there is no interest expressed for any given delivery order, this work may be competed under MAC A. Offerors must possess or have the ability to obtain a Tier I, II, or III Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) for the San Diego, CA homeport. Each contract will include five (5) one-year ordering periods. The supply being procured is the repaired, mission ready vessel, which is returned to service within the Fleet. The solicitation will be issued electronically via System for Award Management (SAM) at http://sam.gov and interested parties must comply with that announcement. Interested offerors should monitor the SAM.gov page for any applicable amendments to this solicitation. Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management in order to participate in this procurement at https://www.sam.gov/portal/public/SAM/. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, which shall be considered by the agency. SAM.gov is the single point of entry for posting of the synopsis and solicitations to the internet. This pre-solicitation notice is for information purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to solicit contractual offers or award of contracts. The Government is not soliciting, nor will it accept, proposals as a result of this synopsis. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any questions submitted or information provided as a result of this notice. The solicitation is forthcoming.

title: Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) Modeling & Simulation Support
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is being issued by the Department of the Army, on behalf of Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Fires. PAE Fires is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to identify qualified, experienced, and interested sources capable of providing specialized engineering, modeling, simulation, and software support for the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) Project Office in support of the AN/TPY-2 Terminal Mode. The contractor shall provide AN/TPY-2 Terminal Mode support for delivery of AN/TPY-2 source code, development, documentation (including appropriate, red-lined documents), integration, and support of the THAAD Modeling and Simulation (M&S) products. The contractor shall deliver tactical CX Terminal Mode (TM) software products (tactical source code and tactical executables), including incremental development releases, Engineering Releases and Final Releases. The contractor shall support integration of CX TM software into the THAAD M&S products, to include on-site support as needed. The contractor shall support the resolution of CX TM-related observations made by the THAAD M&S products during all phases of development and integration, as well as on-going system testing Note that this is not a request for quotes. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. This RFI seeks industry comments to assist the Government in locating potential sources with the ability to satisfy its requirement. Please provide the following Point of Contact Information: Company: Address: Point of Contact: Phone Number: Fax Numbers: Email Address: DUNS Number: CAGE Code: Business Size and Classification (Large Business, Small Business, 8(a), Woman-Owned/Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned, Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Veteran-Owned, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned): Potential sources are invited to submit a Capabilities Statement up to five (5) pages per each of the four (4) major tasks, as described above, to the "RFI: THAAD Modeling and Simulation Support". All responses should be submitted via e-mail address to jonathan.w.dickens.civ@army.mil and sean.c.allan.civ@mail.mil. Only attach MS Word/Excel compatible files or Adobe Acrobat PDF files in electronic correspondence. PM THAAD will not acknowledge receipt of responses to this RFI. Telephonic inquiries will not be considered.

title: Genudbud: Rollatorer til Esbjerg Kommune (Rollatorer med 4 hjul, skubbes)
description: Esbjerg Kommune udbyder en rammeaftale vedrørende levering af rollatorer til kommunens hjælpemiddeldepot. Udbuddet gennemføres som et offentligt EU-udbud med tildeling på baggrund af bedste forhold mellem kvalitet og pris. Da der tidligere er indgået kontrakt på øvrige produktområder, omfatter nærværende udbud alene rollatorer med 4 hjul, skubbes (tidligere delaftale 1). Evalueringen omfatter både pris, kvalitet og afprøvning af vareprøver. Rammeaftalen forventes at træde i kraft den 1. marts 2027.
